notes: Fixed: the day-change figure in the portfolio header showed $0.00 all day even when your shares had moved. The app was comparing dates written two different ways ("18 Aug 2026" against "2026-08-18"), which made it treat every holding as if it had been bought at today's close — and those count as zero by design. Dates are now compared as dates. The heading also correctly says "Today's change" again when the latest market day is today.
